audit.method: Enumerate tracked TS/TSX/JS/JSX files from git ls-tree at sourceSha; read git blobs, parse with TypeScript 5.9.3; collect import/export declarations, import types, literal dynamic imports and require calls. Separate test/spec/testUtils/test-utils support. Include manifest-only dependencies separately. No reference checkout or old port is read.

nonliteralImports.disposition: Self-reference test loops bounded by pinned manifest exports: internals, then stable public root families. External root is @base-ui/react; no new external package. Runtime execution remains integration/inventory qualification.

audit.coverage: All observed external package roots and production subpaths are classified below. Relative imports and package #imports are internal; #imports are specified in package-contract.json. This is a pinned-source dependency audit, not a claim about future compiled output.

@floating-ui/dom.reason: Replace React binding's geometry runtime and exposed Middleware/VirtualElement/Placement/etc types with the framework-neutral DOM package. computePosition, autoUpdate, platform, middleware and getOverflowAncestors are actual upstream reexports. React UseFloatingOptions/Return cannot be blindly reexported; owned RC13 interfaces replace those wrapper types.

@floating-ui/utils.reason: Direct runtime/type imports require a direct dependency; do not rely on @floating-ui/dom's transitive installation.

@solidjs/web.role: matching DOM/server renderer, JSX and native event types

@date-fns/tz.evidence: TemporalAdapterDateFns.ts imports TZDate unconditionally; timezone support is not a separately lazy optional import.

luxon.correction: Upstream exports the adapter but declares luxon only in devDependencies. Solid declares an optional runtime peer, required when importing this adapter.

@types/luxon.role: adapter declaration dependency, no runtime import
@types/luxon.reason: Public method signatures expose DateTime; luxon does not ship those declarations. Optional at package level only because ordinary entrypoints must never traverse the adapter's declarations. Do not copy upstream ts-nocheck or its disabled augmentation to evade validation.

consumerCases: ordinary root and component imports with all four optional peers absent
date-fns adapter with date-fns and @date-fns/tz only
Luxon adapter with luxon and @types/luxon only
requested adapter without its runtime peer fails locally without affecting ordinary imports
Bundler and NodeNext skipLibCheck=false with no React ambient types

upstreamUtilities.decision: Do not install: package contains React peers and store/hook code. Adapt source-mapped pure leaves with MIT notices and replace framework machinery in the assigned foundations.
upstreamUtilities.tinyHelperPolicy: Assess source behavior, size and license per leaf. Pure clamp/array equality/cleanup/owner helpers are licensed one-time Base UI adaptations, not separate external donors. getReactElementRef, safeReact and fastHooks are framework-only and must not be imitated.

react-dom.reason: @solidjs/web renderer/Portal and owned lifecycle; no flushSync compatibility layer

@floating-ui/react-dom.reason: Substantial React geometry binding replaced with @floating-ui/dom and separately pinned donor adapted to RC13

use-sync-external-store.reason: React subscription compatibility is framework-only; native accessors/memos and setup-owned subscriptions preserve observable behavior

reselect.reason: Framework-neutral, not React-only. Observed only in utils/lruMemoize and store selector machinery. Native Solid derivations replace that machinery; do not copy a library or install it speculatively. State owner may request a justified pure use with cache semantics preserved.

@babel/runtime.reason: Declared upstream build helper, no authored production imports found. RC13 compiler output uses external @solidjs/web helpers; build owner must audit any new helper before requesting it.

testOnlyImports.@base-ui/react: Self-reference roots/subpaths in upstream tests and toast/utils/test-utils.tsx; translate to completed family-local Solid entries, never install React package.
testOnlyImports.@base-ui/utils: Test helper imports follow the same foundation adaptations as production.
testOnlyImports.vitest: Retain exact 4.1.11 development-only; vitest/browser remains final-browser infrastructure.
testOnlyImports.@vitest/browser-playwright: Final browser owner requests compatible exact tooling later.
testOnlyImports.vitest-browser-react: Replace React browser rendering in bsolid-browser.
testOnlyImports.react-router: React-only integration scenarios require explicit test adaptation, not a runtime dependency.
testOnlyImports.react-dom: client/server subpaths replaced by Solid DOM/server harness.
testOnlyImports.react: Replace React act/rerender with native harness.
testOnlyImports.date-fns: Locale test subpaths use the adapter's exact development installation.
testOnlyImports.reselect: Selector behavior tests assigned to bsolid-state; library not installed.

donor.decision: Read immutable donor source and adapt maintained positioning logic into owned RC13 foundations; do not add solid-floating-ui or Solid 1 reactive utility packages as runtime dependencies. Donor source never overrides Base UI behavior or RC13 semantics.
donor.reconciliation: Explicit developer-requested updates via separate source state; no automatic adaptation overwrite.
donor.noticeHandoff: Actual adaptation owners retain donor MIT/source-local notices and send staged NOTICE additions to distribution owner. bsolid-donor-notices gates adopted-source packing, including inherited Adobe Apache/React NOTICE and aria-hidden MIT where applicable.

integrationRequests.dependencies: existing pinned toolchain plus requested jest-dom 6.9.1
integrationRequests.rootTsconfigRequest: Superseded by harness-owned test/contracts/tsconfig.json; root typescript remains strict source check.

integrationRequests.request: upstream:init/update/status/verify/abandon -> node scripts/upstream/cli.mjs <command>; test:upstream:git -> node --test test/upstream/git/*.test.mjs; --source solid-floating-ui selects donor
integrationRequests.dependencies: Node builtins and RTK Git; verify remains explicit fail-closed reservation

integrationRequests.request: test:coverage-map -> node scripts/tracking/cli.mjs check; inventory:generate -> generate; test:tracking -> node --test test/tracking/*.test.mjs
docs:sync -> node docs/scripts/sync/index.mjs; docs:test:content -> node --test docs/scripts/sync/content.test.mjs; exact parser pins above
Floating DOM/utils and React-only dependency audit coordination
